# fastmcp-slim 3.4.2 license evidence

The frozen `fastmcp_slim-3.4.2-py3-none-any.whl` declares Apache-2.0 in its
metadata but contains no separate license text. The files here supply that
text from the **same upstream package and release**, without modifying the
wheel or inferring permission from a neighboring distribution.

The upstream `v3.4.2` tag resolves to commit
`3b8538e2422a1c43fdb69661c610de7985b785f2` in `PrefectHQ/fastmcp`.
`UPSTREAM_PYPROJECT.toml` is the unchanged `fastmcp_slim/pyproject.toml` at that
commit: its package name is `fastmcp-slim`, it declares Apache-2.0, and its
repository points to the same project. `LICENSE` is the unchanged root license
from that exact commit. Tag-based and commit-based downloads were compared.

The complete, non-truncated Git tree was checked for NOTICE files; none were
listed. `PROVENANCE.json` records original URLs, tag/commit identity, tree
response hash, wheel hash and the hashes of these source files. This evidence
addresses the missing license text for this package only; it does not replace
the notices carried by other dependency wheels or approve engineering results.
